mapper.select: SELECT id, status, mood, doing, notes, todos, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM blog_talk_sidebar WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO blog_talk_sidebar (id, status, mood, doing, notes, todos) VALUES (#{id}, #{status}, #{mood}, #{doing}, #{notes}, #{todos})
